record.paper_title: Some problems and conjectures about L2-invariants
record.original_question: Let M be an aspherical closed manifold and let M[i] be the finite covers associated to a finite-index normal chain of π_1(M). Must the normalized logarithmic torsion in homology vanish outside the middle odd degree, meaning lim_{i→∞} ln|tors H_n(M[i]; Z)|/[G:G_i] = 0 for every n with 2n+1 ≠ dim(M)? If dim(M)=2m+1 is odd, must M be det-L2-acyclic and satisfy lim_{i→∞} ln|tors H_m(M[i]; Z)|/[G:G_i] = (-1)^m ρ^{(2)}(M̃)?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 6.8 (Homological torsion growth and L2-torsion). Let M be an aspherical closed manifold. Then we get for any natural number n with 2n + 1 6= dim(M) lim i→∞ ln |tors Hn(M[i]; Z)| / [G : Gi] = 0. If the dimension dim(M) = 2m + 1 is odd, then Mf is det-L2-acyclic and we get lim i→∞ ln |tors Hm(M[i]; Z)| / [G : Gi] = (−1)m · ρ(2)(Mf).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a closed aspherical manifold with fundamental group $G = \pi_1(M)$, and let $\widetilde{M}$ denote its universal cover. Fix a descending chain $G = G_0 \supseteq G_1 \supseteq G_2 \supseteq \cdots$ of normal subgroups of finite index in $G$ with $\bigcap_i G_i = \{1\}$, and let $M[i] \to M$ be the finite covering corresponding to $G_i$, so $[G:G_i]$ is the degree of this cover. For a finitely generated abelian group $A$, write $\mathrm{tors}\,A$ for its torsion subgroup and $|\mathrm{tors}\,A|$ for its order.

Prove or disprove the following two assertions.

(a) For every integer $n \geq 0$ with $2n+1 \neq \dim(M)$,
$$\lim_{i \to \infty} \frac{\ln |\mathrm{tors}\, H_n(M[i];\mathbb{Z})|}{[G:G_i]} = 0.$$

(b) If $\dim(M) = 2m+1$ is odd, then $\widetilde{M}$ is det-$L^2$-acyclic (i.e., its $L^2$-Betti numbers vanish and the Fuglede–Kadison determinants of its combinatorial Laplacians are defined and nonzero, so that the $L^2$-torsion $\rho^{(2)}(\widetilde{M}) \in \mathbb{R}$ is well-defined), and
$$\lim_{i \to \infty} \frac{\ln |\mathrm{tors}\, H_m(M[i];\mathbb{Z})|}{[G:G_i]} = (-1)^m \, \rho^{(2)}(\widetilde{M}).$$
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture relating normalized logarithmic torsion growth in homology of finite covers to L²-torsion of aspherical closed manifolds is widely regarded as open. It has been verified in special cases (e.g., when the manifold admits a nontrivial S¹-action, or when π₁(M) contains a nontrivial elementary amenable normal subgroup, giving vanishing on both sides), and recent work continues to establish partial results for specific classes such as polynomially growing free-by-cyclic groups and books of I-bundles, but the full conjecture remains unresolved.

status_evidence.title: A Survey on L2-torsion (Lück)
status_evidence.snippet: Conjecture on Homological torsion growth and L2-torsion for aspherical closed manifolds; known in cases of nontrivial S¹-action or elementary amenable normal subgroup.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture stated as open, with partial results in special cases.

status_evidence.title: Virtual homological torsion: abundance versus growth in books of I-bundles
status_evidence.snippet: Recent investigation of torsion growth, indicating the general conjecture is still active.
status_evidence.claim: Ongoing research on torsion growth supports that the conjecture is not fully resolved.

status_evidence.title: Torsion homology growth of polynomially growing free-by-cyclic groups
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes the conjectural equality for specific group classes.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist; general case open.
